_comment: Single source of truth for every bundled asset's license. scripts/ac/credits.py renders CREDITS.txt + LICENSES.md from this into each track folder. Bundle ONLY genuinely CC0/PD assets.

bundled_assets.name: Tilt-up concrete (building set, mined from Hamburg by 4r)
bundled_assets.source: Hamburg by 4r (AC mod), nhh_detail.kn5 material 'concretebunker' (TextureCom/KitBash3D map TCom_Wall_ConcreteBunker2), mined with scripts/modkit/extract_kn5.py; see assets/textures/SOURCES.txt
bundled_assets._note: Corrected 2026-10-11 (ledger 0048, tracks/lookout-lariat/V3-PLAN.md P0 step 9, Kevin's approval). Until then this entry read 'Concrete034 / ambientCG / CC0-1.0'. That was true of the June bytes (3c8e502) and stopped being true at a7f4d6f, which replaced assets/textures/building_diffuse.jpg + building_normal.jpg with the Hamburg maps (md5 0df17da92f1fe9bb302be58a942c9c13 / d9d60d5ba84030af5084fca7929c2240) and updated SOURCES.txt but not this file. The genuine CC0 ambientCG Concrete034 pair is ../_salvage/k10-sd-v021/assets/textures/building_*.jpg (md5 163f7b7bbc40f02101e0267df70ec350 / 972d29fbb0b54a90418a77efd4366cac); tools/pack_release.py swaps it in under the same names for Lake Murray's CC0 zip. AFFECTED PACKAGES, read 2026-10-11 from each installed kn5's texture table (read-only): the Hamburg bytes are embedded in lookout_lariat (the build behind public k10-colorado v0.14.0, ledger 0048), imi_motorsports, high_plains, pueblo_motorsports_park, second_creek, sand_creek_raceway, san_diego_freeway and san_diego_lake_murray_v3 (Lake Murray's Full package, local only). All eight installed folders carry a CREDITS.txt/LICENSES.md generated from the old entry that calls those bytes CC0 Concrete034. tools/pack_release.py replaces that text in Lake Murray's Full zip (release/full/LICENSES.md credits Hamburg) and swaps the bytes in its CC0 zip, but copies san_diego_freeway's kn5 and its CC0-claiming texts into san_diego_freeway_v0.5.0.zip unchanged. Not checked: whether each published zip is byte-identical to its installed copy, and Aspen and the rally stages (not installed). Public downloads are V3-PLAN D0's business, handled separately; this file is only the record.

The race kn5s (_race, _closure_race_cw, _closure_race_acw) ship wherever Kevin chooses: tools/pack_release.py leaves them out of cc0/ by default and keeps them with --with-race.

bundled_assets.name: Modern LED street light (generated) — ledger 0056
bundled_assets.source: self-made: tools/make_streetlight_led.py, a deterministic generator (rerun = byte-identical; tests/tools/test_streetlight_led.py checks it). Dimensions from public standards only: Caltrans Standard Plan ES-6A (Type 21 pole 35 ft, 12 ft mast arm, 38'-9" mounting height) and City of San Diego SDE-101 (12 ft arm for the steel standard). No third-party mesh or texture; it binds the engine's own LIGHTPOST / LIGHTS pbr rows (solid_metal_dark.png / solid_lens_warm.png)
bundled_assets._note: Replaces Kevin's decimated Street_Lamp (assets/models/lamp_post.obj + lamp_lens.obj, from the Dropbox Street_Lamp.zip, licence unrecorded) on Lake Murray by track.config.json scenery.streetlights.model = led_cobra; the old OBJs stay in the repo for the one-key rollback (street_lamp_2026_10).

bundled_assets.name: Sandstone / conglomerate road cut (generated) — ledger 0054 P4
bundled_assets.source: generated by tracks/san-diego-lake-murray/textures/make_sandstone_cut.py (deterministic, seed 20261026; PIL only, no captured pixels); lives in the track's own textures/ folder, bound by track.config.json texture_overrides["1GRASS_ROCK"] (scripts/ac/pbr.py row 1GRASS_ROCK, stock skin stone_tan.png), synced into the workshop by tools/ship_sd.sh TRACK_TEXTURES and ship.json
bundled_assets._note: The north network's cut faces (tools/rock_faces_blend.py: 1GRASS_ROCK_* split out of the ground tiles). Drawn, not captured: tan bedded sandstone with rounded cobbles, the Stadium Conglomerate / Friars sandstone the Mission Gorge cuts stand in. Ours outright, safe in both the CC0 and the full package.
